correctness.rationale: Self-contained trace-congruence proof, classical Möbius-growth theorem, cycle derivation, and exhaustive finite checks are documented in RESULT.md and SELF_AUDIT.md.

originality.rationale: Qualified to the best of our knowledge. Classical trace/history theory is not claimed as new; searches found no prior application to coloring-channel capacity, while the April 2026 source explicitly leaves cycles open.

value.rationale: The result gives an exact capacity formula for arbitrary coloring-channel pairs graphs and closes the explicitly open cycle family, rather than only improving a numerical bound.

disclaimer: Not independent validation, peer review, or a guarantee of first discovery.
